report.name: Sedile
report.site_is: A concept online showroom and demo store for office chairs under the invented brand 'sedile.'. The page description calls it 'a calm digital showroom for office chairs. Explore in 3D and find the chair that fits your work style.', and the README (title 'Sedile — Premium 3D Chair Finder') says: 'A white, editorial furniture showroom where every chair is a real, slowly rotating 3D object.' It is built with React and three.js. All 16 chairs are drawn in real time from 3D models that are generated in code (README: 'No 3D models were supplied, so all 13 chair families are modelled in code'). The site has a four-question Chair Finder, a filterable catalogue, product pages with a 3D viewer and live colour/base/configuration options, a cart drawer, a wishlist and a demo checkout, plus collections, designers, about, journal and support pages. The footer states 'Demo storefront — no real orders are processed.'
report.tagline_verbatim: Explore our collection and find the chair that fits your work style.

report.name: Emberpost
report.site_is: A concept landing page for Emberpost, an invented people-first email app that files every email under the person who sent it. Repo README: 'Emberpost — people-first email', with the signature interaction 'Fully clickable inbox: switch people, reply, mark done/undo, keyboard shortcuts' and the signature animation 'Hanging people wall: drifting portrait columns that tilt toward the pointer'. The page title is 'Emberpost — email sorted by the people behind it', the page description says 'Emberpost groups every email by the person who sent it. A concept landing page with a working sample inbox you can click through.', and the footer line under the wordmark is 'Email organised around the people behind it.' The site states its demo nature in its own words: 'Emberpost is a concept product for a design portfolio. People and messages are sample data.' (footer) and 'This is a demo form. Nothing you type is sent or saved.' (waitlist). It is one of six pages in the public repo gireeshkumarreddy/landing-concepts (README: 'Six independent, fully interactive landing pages'), built with React, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Motion and Lenis smooth scrolling. The demo is set at Halden Supply, a fictional outdoor-goods brand preparing a spring launch (data.js).
report.tagline_verbatim: Email organised around the people behind it.
